locked_narration: Mark's finger hovered over the delete key. The resignation letter was already written. Six months of nights and weekends had built his freelance business. The clients were lined up. The cash was waiting. But suddenly, that boring desk job felt like a warm blanket. Then the panic got louder. A shaky economy. That one time he failed a college project. His brain building a wall between him and his bold goal. Then he saw it. The dread lacked logic. It was simply fear wearing a mask. The ego hates change, so it feeds you doubt. He closed his eyes, took a breath, and clicked send. What has your fear disguised as common sense?
